policy: same prospective AB/BA policy as previous trials; no further micro-optimization cycling

primary_trials.early_reject: Both initial groups increase CPU time or both increase wall time
primary_trials.accept: All three groups lower CPU and wall time and pooled comparison positive
primary_trials.one_fourth_group: Only when all first three CPU reductions positive and exactly two wall reductions positive; require all four CPU and >=3 wall reductions positive and pooled positive

architecture_target: Aim for >=20% total main-thread CPU reduction before expanding this architecture; report actual gains without treating source size as performance progress
measurement_isolation: No compiler, profiler, git operation, disassembler or extra file writes during throughput
subsequent_gates: 2604 strict original per-event and unchanged C++ case hashes; audit every typed receiver assumption
24 continuous raw batches, all >=50 fights/s; report power and observed load
training, deployment SHA and report hash verification
